comment: Shipped analysis profiles. A profile is 'how I analyze this kind of case' — the plugins to enable, an optional starter watchlist, and a dashboard of widgets. SQL widgets use {{evtx}} / {{header_set:Name}} placeholders that bind to whichever table matches that header set in the open case (and {{all:header_set:Name}} unions every matching table, for logs split across many files), so the dashboard is portable. Shipped profiles are read-only; Save-as-profile creates editable copies.

profiles.name: KAPE triage
profiles.description: Windows host triage from KAPE/EvtxECmd output — logon movement, failed-logon spikes, RDP and explicit-credential use, log-tampering signals, and (if a RECmd batch is imported) host facts from the registry — OS version, role, domain, IPs, Sysmon and PowerShell logging posture — plus registry persistence. Seeds a starter IOC watchlist.

query.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteHost) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4624' AND RemoteHost NOT IN ('-','','- (-)')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4625'
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) AS hr, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventId IN ('4624','4625','4648') AND TimeCreated <> '' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr
SELECT RemoteHost, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4624' AND RemoteHost NOT IN ('-','','- (-)') GROUP BY RemoteHost ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT UserName, COUNT(*) c FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4624' AND UserName <> '' GROUP BY UserName ORDER BY c ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Channel LIKE '%TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager%' AND EventId IN ('21','24','25')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4648'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Computer) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE Computer NOT IN ('','-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserName) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE UserName NOT IN ('','-')
SELECT 'First event' AS k, MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) AS v FROM {{evtx}} UNION ALL SELECT 'Last event', MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(TimeCreated)) FROM {{evtx}}

SELECT ValueName AS k, ValueData AS v FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' AND ValueName IN ('ProductName','DisplayVersion','ReleaseId','CurrentBuild','UBR') AND ValueData <> '' ORDER BY CASE ValueName WHEN 'ProductName' THEN 0 WHEN 'DisplayVersion' THEN 1 WHEN 'ReleaseId' THEN 2 WHEN 'CurrentBuild' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

SELECT 'Role' AS k, CASE ValueData WHEN 'WinNT' THEN 'Workstation' WHEN 'ServerNT' THEN 'Member / standalone server' WHEN 'LanmanNT' THEN 'Domain controller' ELSE ValueData END AS v FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Control\ProductOptions' AND ValueName = 'ProductType' UNION ALL SELECT 'Role', '(ProductType not in this RECmd output)' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Control\ProductOptions' AND ValueName = 'ProductType')

SELECT ValueName AS k, CASE WHEN ValueData = '' THEN '(none — workgroup)' ELSE ValueData END AS v FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Services\Tcpip\Parameters' AND ValueName IN ('Domain','NV Domain','Hostname') ORDER BY CASE ValueName WHEN 'Hostname' THEN 0 WHEN 'Domain' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

SELECT CASE ValueName WHEN 'DhcpIPAddress' THEN 'IP (DHCP)' WHEN 'IPAddress' THEN 'IP (static)' ELSE 'Gateway' END AS k, ValueData AS v FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\%' AND ValueName IN ('DhcpIPAddress','IPAddress','DhcpDefaultGateway') AND ValueData NOT IN ('','0.0.0.0') ORDER BY k

SELECT 'Sysmon' AS k, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Installed — ' || COUNT(*) || ' service registry entr' || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN 'y' ELSE 'ies' END ELSE 'Not present in registry' END AS v FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%\Services\Sysmon%'

SELECT CASE ValueName WHEN 'EnableScriptBlockLogging' THEN 'Script block' WHEN 'EnableModuleLogging' THEN 'Module logging' ELSE 'Transcription' END AS k, CASE WHEN ValueData IN ('1','0x1') THEN 'Enabled' WHEN ValueData IN ('0','0x0') THEN 'Disabled' ELSE ValueData END AS v FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell%' AND ValueName IN ('EnableScriptBlockLogging','EnableModuleLogging','EnableTranscripting') UNION ALL SELECT 'Policy', '(not configured — no policy keys)' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell%' AND ValueName IN ('EnableScriptBlockLogging','EnableModuleLogging','EnableTranscripting'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='1102'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{evtx}} WHERE EventId='4719'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{registry}} WHERE KeyPath LIKE '%\Run' OR KeyPath LIKE '%\RunOnce' OR KeyPath LIKE '%\Services%' OR Category LIKE '%Run%' OR Category LIKE '%Service%'
SELECT Category AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{registry}} WHERE Category NOT IN ('','-') GROUP BY Category ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10

profiles.name: ESXi / UAC triage
profiles.description: VMware ESXi support-bundle and UAC Linux host-log triage — one overview of every parsed log (hostd, vmkernel, auth, shell, vobd, vpxa, syslog, rhttpproxy, esxupdate): SSH and sudo activity with source IPs, shell commands, VM power and snapshot operations, vCenter-initiated actions, account/lockdown/firewall changes, and VIB install/remove. Enable the esxi_logs plugin and import the bundle (Winnow expands the archive).

query.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}}
SELECT Log AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} GROUP BY Log ORDER BY c DESC

SELECT 'First' AS k, MIN(TS_NORMALIZE(Timestamp)) AS v FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Timestamp <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'Last', MAX(TS_NORMALIZE(Timestamp)) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Timestamp <> ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='auth' AND Message LIKE '%Accepted%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='auth' AND (Message LIKE '%Failed%' OR Message LIKE '%authentication failure%' OR Message LIKE '%Invalid user%')
SELECT SourceIP AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE SourceIP <> '' GROUP BY SourceIP ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Component IN ('sudo','su') OR Message LIKE '%sudo:%' OR Message LIKE '% su[%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='shell'
SELECT Message, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='shell' AND Message <> '' GROUP BY Message ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='hostd' AND (Message LIKE '%power%' OR Message LIKE '%PowerOn%' OR Message LIKE '%PowerOff%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='hostd' AND Message LIKE '%snapshot%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='vpxa'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='vobd' AND (Message LIKE '%account%' OR Message LIKE '%lockdown%' OR Message LIKE '%firewall%' OR Message LIKE '%Account%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='esxupdate'
SELECT SourceIP AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Log='rhttpproxy' AND SourceIP <> '' GROUP BY SourceIP ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT CASE WHEN Severity='' THEN '(none)' ELSE Severity END AS label, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} GROUP BY Severity ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', TS_NORMALIZE(Timestamp)) AS hr, COUNT(*) c FROM {{all:header_set:ESXi / Linux host logs}} WHERE Timestamp <> '' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr
